packet.title: HTML5 parsing: fn:parse-html and fn:html-doc (implementation, two packets)
packet.summary: Implements fn:parse-html and fn:html-doc with a hand-written HTML5 tokenizer and tree construction on an , giving an arena tree in the XHTML namespace, plus encoding sniffing and legacy decoders.

item.p: F&O 4.0, fn:parse-html and fn:html-doc (the options: method, html-version, encoding, include-template-content; the XHTML namespace result);
HTML Living Standard (WHATWG), 13.2 "Parsing HTML documents" (encoding sniffing 13.2.3, tokenization 13.2.5, tree construction 13.2.6) and 13.5 "Named character references".
Unlocks: XQ40 1,401 (misc-HtmlTestSuite 1,379, from the web-platform-tests HTML suite; fn-parse-html 14; fn-html-doc 8) and XP40 22.
Replaces: the functions are absent (XPST0017). Also the drivers' non-goal test sets misc-HtmlTestSuite, fn-parse-html and fn-html-doc.
7.10a Tokenizer: the tokenizer's 80 states as a loop over a state variable; the named-reference table as a sorted array; encoding sniffing through src/xml_encoding.c.
the insertion modes, the stack of open elements, active formatting elements, the adoption agency algorithm and foster parenting;

these move nodes already built, so construction works on an HTML working tree (glossary ): a node table in allocator memory that is walked with an explicit stack, and sent to the tree builder once the document ends;
the result is an ordinary arena tree in the XHTML namespace (F&O 4.0, fn:parse-html);
fn:html-doc reads bytes through the resolver (BINARY, so sniffing applies).

Header: none. The XML parser's grammar is not used: does not apply to HTML, whose tokenizer is specified as a state machine and whose input never fails. The reasoning applies, recorded in the D-record of 7.10a.

Owns: new src/html.c, src/html_tokenizer.c, src/html_tree_construction.c, src/html_internal.h, src/html_entity_table.c (generated by a new tools/generate-html-entities.py from WHATWG's entities.json), and new src/function_library_html.c.

Gate: ≥ 95 % of misc-HtmlTestSuite and ≥ 90 % of fn-parse-html and fn-html-doc. 7.10a done 2026-10-19 (): the tokenizer and tree construction both, so the gate is met: misc-HtmlTestSuite 1,378 of 1,379, fn-parse-html 22 of 22, fn-html-doc 9 of 10 (XQ40). 7.10b: the list at the end of . 7.10b done 2026-10-19 (): the meta prescan and the change of encoding while parsing, every legacy multi-byte decoder, XHTML parsed as XML, the html5lib tests vendored and run by tests/html5lib_test.c (tree construction 1,749 of 1,753, tokenizer 7,045 of 7,045, encoding 82 of 82), the CLI's static base URI; source locations wait for the processor to keep them.
